tr.name: Turkey
tr.notes: Turkey rows use the local list price because this comparison is for a Turkey-based buyer without a tourist refund.

us.name: United States
us.notes: Apple US prices are shown before sales tax. This prototype adds New York City sales tax by default.

ca.name: Canada
ca.notes: Apple Canada prices are shown before sales tax. This prototype adds Toronto HST by default.

tw.name: Taiwan
tw.notes: Taiwan tourist refunds return the 5% business tax less a 20% administrative fee on the refund amount, for an effective refund of about 3.81% of a tax-included shelf price.

hk.name: Hong Kong
hk.notes: Hong Kong has no sales tax or VAT, so the listed Apple price is already the final retail price for this comparison.

kr.name: South Korea
kr.notes: South Korea supports tourist VAT refunds. This prototype models the pre-fee 10% VAT removal; actual cash refunds can be slightly lower after operator fees.

my.name: Malaysia
my.notes: A reliable current tourist refund rate could not be verified under Malaysia's current SST regime.

ph.name: Philippines
ph.notes: The Philippines tourist VAT refund is modeled using the statutory 12% VAT rate.

uk.name: United Kingdom
uk.notes: UK tourist VAT refunds are not configured in this prototype.

jp.name: Japan
jp.notes: Japan tax-free shopping is modeled using the current 10% consumption tax rate.

ae.name: United Arab Emirates
ae.notes: The UAE tourist refund is modeled as 87% of the 5% VAT component, which is about 4.143% of a tax-included shelf price. The fixed AED 4.80 transaction fee is not deducted here.

vn.name: Vietnam
vn.notes: Vietnam refunds 85% of the standard 10% VAT amount, which is about 7.727% of a tax-included shelf price.

th.name: Thailand
th.notes: Thailand tourist VAT refunds are modeled using the statutory 7% VAT rate. Actual net refunds can be slightly lower after processing fees.

sg.name: Singapore
sg.notes: Singapore tourist refunds are modeled using the statutory 9% GST rate. Actual net refunds can be lower after retailer or refund-agent handling fees.

nz.name: New Zealand
nz.notes: New Zealand does not currently provide a general tourist GST refund scheme for normal in-country Apple Store purchases.

cn.name: China
cn.notes: China tourist refunds are modeled at 9% of shelf price, assuming Apple products follow the 13% VAT / 11% refund track and a 2% refund-agency commission applies.

lu.name: Luxembourg
lu.notes: Luxembourg tourist VAT refunds need manual review before enabling in this prototype.

in.name: India
in.notes: India's international tourist refund rules are limited to specific airport departure retail contexts and are not usable for normal Apple Store purchases in this prototype.
